observations: WP700 G1 intentionally consumes caller-supplied frame identity/content digest plus bounded quality/delta measurements and does not read pixels or infer object/world semantics.

Because the component cannot independently establish that a supplied quality/delta measurement was actually derived from the supplied frame bytes, those numeric measurements are assertions at this boundary unless an exact upstream measurement lineage is supplied and bound.
A frame-content digest proves identity of referenced frame content only; it does not by itself prove that a caller-supplied delta/quality scalar was computed from those bytes.

Therefore the Retina ABI must not upgrade caller-supplied quality/delta values into sensor-observed world truth merely because they pass range validation or are packaged inside a PerceptEvent-shaped output.

This review does not require WP700 to inspect pixels; it requires explicit epistemic/provenance binding so the later perception stack can distinguish caller-asserted measurement candidates from independently observed/verified perception.
counterhypothesis: If WP700 output is explicitly classified as a non-authoritative candidate/readout, preserves the supplied measurement provenance and frame lineage, and no downstream contract treats those scalars as independently observed sensor truth without a stronger measurement receipt, then the caller-assertion ambiguity is contained by construction.
cheapest_discriminator: Hold frame_id, stream_id, generation, continuity epoch and frame-content digest constant while constructing two otherwise valid inputs with conflicting caller-supplied quality/delta measurements (for example low-delta/non-salient versus high-delta/salient). The API may deterministically produce different candidate readouts, but both outputs must retain an explicit non-authoritative/caller-asserted measurement classification or exact measurement provenance. Neither output may claim that the scalar was verified from frame bytes. Add a regression that rejects any attempt to rewrite this classification/provenance into observed sensor authority.
next_exact_action: Active WP700 mutation authority should encode the conflicting-measurement discriminator before terminal component-CI acceptance and ensure any PerceptEvent/readout carries a fail-closed epistemic/provenance marker that cannot be rewritten into independent sensor observation. Preserve the no-pixel-inspection scope and do not grant runtime/perception/GRID/GWT/J-Space/effect/completion credit.
